{
  "name": "ctui",
  "version": "1.0.2",
  "displayName": "ctui",
  "description": "A mod for Claude Code: a docked sidebar with git, context, limits, todo, skills, MCP and agent sections, plus agent and shell toasts and a /ctui settings menu for plugins and themes.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Aliaksandr Katkou"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/a1exk-dev/claude-tui",
  "repository": "https://github.com/a1exk-dev/claude-tui",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "tui",
    "sidebar",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "context_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Context section",
      "description": "Show the context-window section in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "context_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Context folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the Context section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "limits_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Limits section",
      "description": "Show the usage-limits section in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "limits_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Limits folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the Limits section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "limits_cost": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Limits cost",
      "description": "Show this month's cost against your limit; auto hides it on a Claude plan",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "limits_cost_monthly": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Limits monthly cost",
      "description": "Monthly cost limit in USD; 0 shows the total with no limit",
      "default": 100,
      "min": 0
    },
    "todo_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Todo section",
      "description": "Show the todo list section in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "todo_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Todo folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the Todo section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "todo_tools": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Task tools",
      "description": "Give Claude the Task tools (TaskCreate, TaskList, TaskUpdate) on models without them by default, such as Opus 5.x, by setting CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 for the session; the Todo section shows their list. It also keeps TaskCreate, TaskUpdate and a short task-list instruction in Claude's prompt so Claude keeps a list, at about 1.2k cached tokens per request. A change fully reaches Claude from the next /clear",
      "default": true
    },
    "skills_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skills section",
      "description": "Show the skills this chat has used in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "skills_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skills folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the Skills section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "mcp_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "MCP section",
      "description": "Show the MCP servers section in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "mcp_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "MCP folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the MCP section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "agents_enable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Agents & shells section",
      "description": "Show running subagents and background shells in the sidebar",
      "default": true
    },
    "agents_folded": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Agents & shells folded",
      "description": "Start each session with the Agents & shells section folded",
      "default": false
    },
    "agents_toasts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Agent and shell toasts",
      "description": "Show a toast when a subagent or background shell starts, finishes or fails",
      "default": true
    },
    "order": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sidebar order",
      "description": "Sidebar sections in order, as comma-separated ids: context, limits, todo, skills, mcp, agents. Unknown ids are ignored; missing ones follow in this order",
      "default": ""
    },
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sidebar theme",
      "description": "Theme for the sidebar: inherit follows your Claude Code theme, or pick a ctui theme",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "catppuccin",
        "catppuccin-latte",
        "ethereal",
        "everforest",
        "flexoki-light",
        "gruvbox",
        "hackerman",
        "kanagawa",
        "last-horizon",
        "lumon",
        "lupine",
        "matte-black",
        "miasma",
        "nord",
        "osaka-jade",
        "retro-82",
        "ristretto",
        "rose-pine",
        "solitude",
        "tokyo-night",
        "vantablack",
        "white"
      ],
      "default": "inherit"
    }
  }
}
